messages:
deploybot: PROD deploy STARTED by amy — tag=v3.6.0, commit=d4f3a9b. Canary 5% in us-west-2. Change window 2026-03-20 22:00-23:00 UTC. Runbook: https://runbook.internal/redwood/prod-deploy-3.6.0 :rocket:
amy: smoke checks running, will watch p95/err rates and cost telemetry.
chris: I'll tail traces and kv-cache metrics. ping me if p50 p95 diverge.
infra-bot: canary metrics update (5m): p95 latency +12%, errors 0.1% (baseline 0.05%). Thresholds not breached yet.
dave: seeing increased cache miss rate on canary hosts, likely config churn from runtime flags. quick grep shows `--kv-cache-size=1024` on new image.
rachel: suggestion: if canary latency > +15% or errors >0.5% within 10m, pin canary back to previous image and hold promotion. fallback policy in runbook section 2.2. :warning:
amy: agreed. holding tight. can we try rolling the canary back to v3.5.2 (commit a1b2c3d) if metric trend keeps rising?
infra-bot: 8m update: p95 now +18%, errors 0.6% — auto-alert triggered.
amy: initiating canary rollback -> `deploybot rollback --env=prod --pool=canary --to-tag=v3.5.2`
deploybot: ROLLBACK started for canary -> target tag=v3.5.2, commit=a1b2c3d. See deploy id: deploy-prod-3065432109-rb1.
infra-bot: Canary rollback COMPLETE. Metrics restored to baseline within 3m: p95 back to +2%, errors 0.03%, kv-cache miss normalized.
chris: good catch. I've posted traces to #eng-runtime for root-cause triage. initial lead: new kernel path in runtime causing hot-path cache thrash.
dave: created a quick patch to the runtime flag gating (will submit PR referencing issue #412).
amy: given canary rollback success, promoting conservative footprint: pin 20% of traffic to v3.5.2 for 30m, leave rest at v3.5.2 as well until fix is validated.
rachel: will add a note to release notes: "v3.6.0 canary paused due to kv-cache regression; rolled back to v3.5.2 while fix validated."
amy: devfix merged (PR #789). new image built with minor lint/runtime gating fix -> tag=v3.6.0-patch1, commit=e5f7b2c. Running small canary 5% on us-west-2.
deploybot: PROD deploy STARTED (re-deploy) by amy — tag=v3.6.0-patch1, commit=e5f7b2c. Canary 5% in us-west-2.
infra-bot: canary metrics (5m): p95 +1%, errors 0.02% — healthy.
chris: running long-tail and throughput tests, nothing anomalous so far.
amy: after 30m monitoring, metrics stable. proceeding with staged promote: 20% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m holds.
deploybot: PROMOTION in progress: 20% -> 50%.
infra-bot: 50% -> metrics stable.
deploybot: PROMOTION COMPLETE: v3.6.0-patch1 promoted to 100% in prod. Final tag=e5f7b2c (v3.6.0-patch1). deploy id: deploy-prod-3065432109-2.
amy: post-deploy smoke pass ✅. Running full postmortem template (postmortem draft in #postmortems).
rachel: release notes updated with rollback + patch details. Ops: pinned history entry for audit: commit d4f3a9b (rolled), a1b2c3d (rollback target), e5f7b2c (final).
chris: followup action: investigate kernel scheduling and kv-cache interaction (owner: chris, ETA 48h).
dave: will cut a small canary test harness to reproduce in staging.
amy: thanks all — closing thread. :thumbsup:
